thread:
Samir (CS): quick weekly pulse for Trident — noticed p99 spikes on a couple routes, sending screenshots from the console: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/trident/health :eyes:
Priya (SRE): saw that too, mostly during their peak sync imports (~11:30 PST). p95 mostly stable, p99 jumps ~400-800ms on streaming routes.
Jules (ML Eng): which models/routes? can you paste the route names and model variants?
Samir (CS): main ones: `/chat/completions` using `redwood-vicuna-13b-q4` (streaming) and fallback `redwood-vicuna-13b-q4-cpu` (non-streaming). Also `/assistant/embedding` with `embed-2-small` (non-streaming). p95 numbers look fine, p99 for streaming route ~2.2s->3.1s some minutes yesterday.
Ava (CSM): Trident is in onboarding ramp, their monthly spend projection jumped 18% last week. they're excited but worried about UX if latency keeps spiking.
Alex (AE): FYI renewal convo in 6 weeks, we should keep them happy. any quick mitigations?
Priya (SRE): first pass: looks like KV cache miss rate increased during import bursts -> more token decode work. I can patch routing to prefer cached nodes for their tenant for the next 2 hours.
Jules (ML Eng): also saw GPU churn on the pool hosting vicuna-13b-q4. Could be autoscale cooldowns + long-lived streaming connections. If streaming sessions keep warm kvs we shouldn't be evicting.
Samir (CS): action: Priya do temporary routing pin, Jules investigate autoscale config, Ava coordinate with Kerry to reschedule heavy imports out of peak if possible.
Kerry (Trident): thanks — we run nightly dataset ingests. we can shift to 1:30am PST if that helps. want to avoid any downtime.
Priya (SRE): pinning routing now for Trident to node-set `trident-pref` (will prefer warm cache). I/O: `routes: /chat/completions -> node_set: trident-pref` (applied).
OncallBot: Incident created INC-4520 for p99_latency_spike_trident. Priority: P2. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lag-investigation
Jules (ML Eng): repro notes I'm collecting — seeing streaming tail latency caused by intermittent KV GC when memory pressure hits ~86%. sending logs: ```
[2026-03-18T18:30:12Z] model=vicuna-13b-q4 node=node-37 kv_gc=started
[2026-03-18T18:30:13Z] model=vicuna-13b-q4 node=node-37 active_streams=12 decode_ms=310
[2026-03-18T18:30:13Z] p99=3120ms p95=210ms
```
Samir (CS): thanks — can we estimate customer-perceived tokens lost or errors? they reported a couple UI refreshes but no actual 5xx errors.
Priya (SRE): error rate stayed low (<0.2%). most are latency degradations not failures. Cost impact: extra CPU and GPU cycles from re-decodes bumped their spend ~6% over baseline during the window.
Ava (CSM): I'll flag this in the QBR notes. also requesting a short summary for Trident's C-suite: can we have a 1-paragraph explanation + 3 action items?
Jules (ML Eng): draft: "We observed intermittent p99 latency spikes on streaming completions caused by node-level KV cache GC coinciding with Trident's import bursts. We pinned their routing to warm nodes and will adjust autoscale/cooldown to reduce churn. Recommended items: 1) shift heavy ingests off-peak, 2) tune GC thresholds for Trident node-set, 3) enable short-term increased reserved capacity during onboarding ramp."
Samir (CS): that's perfect — Ava can you send that to Kerry?
Ava (CSM): on it. Kerry, I'll DM a cleaned version and propose the ingest shift window.
Kerry (Trident): appreciate it. also curious if streaming vs non-streaming tradeoffs mean we should prefer non-streaming for long historical generation tasks?
Jules (ML Eng): for long generations non-streaming can be cheaper and more stable, but you lose incremental UX. For Trident's import-driven spikes non-streaming for batch jobs is recommended.
Priya (SRE): monitoring note: added an alert to reduce false positives — will alert if p99>2s AND kv_gc_events>3 in 5m window.
Samir (CS): next check-in Friday 11am PT. can we mark owner list: Priya (SRE) - mitigation, Jules (ML Eng) - root cause & tuning, Ava (CSM) - customer comms.
Alex (AE): I'll include the mitigation status in renewal tracker. low risk if we close in 2 weeks. :thumbsup:
OncallBot: Incident INC-4520 updated: status=mitigated (temporary routing pin applied).
Samir (CS): thanks everyone, will update Trident thread and close this Slack thread after Friday follow-up.
Ava (CSM): quick note: Trident granted access to extended observability (7d traces) — should help verify after gc tuning.
Jules (ML Eng): adding GC tuning PR to review: `pr/485-kv-gc-tuning` — ETA 48h.
Priya (SRE): rolling monitor changes out now.
Kerry (Trident): thanks all — appreciate quick response.
Samir (CS): end of thread — recorded in the weekly health doc.
